items.name: big-calendar
items.title: Big Calendar
items.description: React Big Calendar themed with shadcn/ui CSS variables. Ships the calendar wrapper component and the stylesheet that drives light/dark dynamic theming.
items.author: Jonas List (https://jonas-list.vercel.app)
items.docs: Render with a localizer, e.g. `const localizer = momentLocalizer(moment)`. Tag events via `eventPropGetter` returning `{ className: 'event-variant-primary' }` (also `-secondary`, `-outline`). For drag-and-drop wrap with `withDragAndDrop` from `react-big-calendar/lib/addons/dragAndDrop`.

items.name: event-form
items.title: Calendar Event Form
items.description: Accessible create-event form (react-hook-form + zod) used by the Big Calendar demo dialog. Includes a native select control.
items.author: Jonas List (https://jonas-list.vercel.app)
